fluid_group.description: Limit fluid objects to this collection

adapt_margin.description: Margin added around fluid to minimize boundary interference

adapt_threshold.description: Minimum amount of fluid grid values (smoke density, fuel and heat) a cell can contain, before it is considered empty

use_adaptive_domain.description: Adapt simulation resolution and size to fluid

resolution_max.description: Resolution used for the fluid domain. Value corresponds to the longest domain side (resolution for other domain sides is calculated automatically).

use_collision_border_front.description: Enable collisions with front domain border

use_collision_border_back.description: Enable collisions with back domain border

use_collision_border_right.description: Enable collisions with right domain border

use_collision_border_left.description: Enable collisions with left domain border

use_collision_border_top.description: Enable collisions with top domain border

use_collision_border_bottom.description: Enable collisions with bottom domain border

gravity.description: Gravity in X, Y and Z direction

domain_type.description: Change domain type of the simulation

alpha.description: Buoyant force based on smoke density (higher value results in faster rising smoke)

beta.description: Buoyant force based on smoke heat (higher value results in faster rising smoke)

dissolve_speed.description: Determine how quickly the smoke dissolves (lower value makes smoke disappear faster)

vorticity.description: Amount of turbulence and rotation in smoke

highres_sampling.description: Method for sampling the high resolution flow

use_dissolve_smoke_log.description: Dissolve smoke in a logarithmic fashion. Dissolves quickly at first, but lingers longer.

burning_rate.description: Speed of the burning reaction (higher value results in smaller flames)

flame_smoke.description: Amount of smoke created by burning fuel

flame_ignition.description: Minimum temperature of the flames (higher value results in faster rising flames)

flame_max_temp.description: Maximum temperature of the flames (higher value results in faster rising flames)

flame_smoke_color.description: Color of smoke emitted from burning fuel

noise_pos_scale.description: Scale of noise (higher value results in larger vortices)

noise_scale.description: The noise simulation is scaled up by this factor (compared to the base resolution of the domain)

flip_ratio.description: PIC/FLIP Ratio. A value of 1.0 will result in a completely FLIP based simulation. Use a lower value for simulations which should produce smaller splashes.

particle_number.description: Particle number factor (higher value results in more particles)

particle_min.description: Minimum number of particles per cell (ensures that each cell has at least this amount of particles)

particle_max.description: Maximum number of particles per cell (ensures that each cell has at most this amount of particles)

particle_radius.description: Particle radius factor. Increase this value if the simulation appears to leak volume, decrease it if the simulation seems to gain volume.

particle_band_width.description: Particle (narrow) band width (higher value results in thicker band and more particles)

use_fractions.description: Fractional obstacles improve and smoothen the fluid-obstacle boundary

fractions_threshold.description: Determines how much fluid is allowed in an obstacle cell (higher values will tag a boundary cell as an obstacle easier and reduce the boundary smoothening effect)

fractions_distance.description: Determines how far apart fluid and obstacle are (higher values will result in fluid being further away from obstacles, smaller values will let fluid move towards the inside of obstacles)

sys_particle_maximum.description: Maximum number of fluid particles that are allowed in this simulation

use_viscosity.description: Simulate fluids with high viscosity using a special solver

viscosity_value.description: Viscosity of liquid (higher values result in more viscous fluids, a value of 0 will still apply some viscosity)

use_diffusion.description: Enable fluid diffusion settings (e.g. viscosity, surface tension)

surface_tension.description: Surface tension of liquid (higher value results in greater hydrophobic behavior)

viscosity_base.description: Viscosity setting: value that is multiplied by 10 to the power of (exponent*-1)

viscosity_exponent.description: Negative exponent for the viscosity value (to simplify entering small values e.g. 5*10^-6)

mesh_concave_upper.description: Upper mesh concavity bound (high values tend to smoothen and fill out concave regions)

mesh_concave_lower.description: Lower mesh concavity bound (high values tend to smoothen and fill out concave regions)

mesh_scale.description: The mesh simulation is scaled up by this factor (compared to the base resolution of the domain). For best meshing, it is recommended to adjust the mesh particle radius alongside this value.

mesh_generator.description: Which particle level set generator to use

use_speed_vectors.description: Caches velocities of mesh vertices. These will be used (automatically) when rendering with motion blur enabled.

mesh_particle_radius.description: Particle radius factor (higher value results in larger (meshed) particles). Needs to be adjusted after changing the mesh scale.

sndparticle_potential_min_wavecrest.description: Lower clamping threshold for marking fluid cells as wave crests (lower value results in more marked cells)

sndparticle_potential_max_wavecrest.description: Upper clamping threshold for marking fluid cells as wave crests (higher value results in less marked cells)

sndparticle_potential_min_trappedair.description: Lower clamping threshold for marking fluid cells where air is trapped (lower value results in more marked cells)

sndparticle_potential_max_trappedair.description: Upper clamping threshold for marking fluid cells where air is trapped (higher value results in less marked cells)

sndparticle_potential_min_energy.description: Lower clamping threshold that indicates the fluid speed where cells start to emit particles (lower values result in generally more particles)

sndparticle_potential_max_energy.description: Upper clamping threshold that indicates the fluid speed where cells no longer emit more particles (higher value results in generally less particles)

sndparticle_sampling_wavecrest.description: Maximum number of particles generated per wave crest cell per frame

sndparticle_sampling_trappedair.description: Maximum number of particles generated per trapped air cell per frame

sndparticle_bubble_buoyancy.description: Amount of buoyancy force that rises bubbles (high value results in bubble movement mainly upwards)

sndparticle_bubble_drag.description: Amount of drag force that moves bubbles along with the fluid (high value results in bubble movement mainly along with the fluid)

sndparticle_boundary.description: How particles that left the domain are treated

sndparticle_combined_export.description: Determines which particle systems are created from secondary particles

sndparticle_potential_radius.description: Radius to compute potential for each cell (higher values are slower but create smoother potential grids)

sndparticle_update_radius.description: Radius to compute position update for each particle (higher values are slower but particles move less chaotic)

particle_scale.description: The particle simulation is scaled up by this factor (compared to the base resolution of the domain)

guide_alpha.description: Guiding weight (higher value results in greater lag)

guide_beta.description: Guiding size (higher value results in larger vortices)

guide_vel_factor.description: Guiding velocity factor (higher value results in greater guiding velocities)

guide_source.description: Choose where to get guiding velocities from

guide_parent.description: Use velocities from this object for the guiding effect (object needs to have fluid modifier and be of type domain))

cache_frame_start.description: Frame on which the simulation starts (first frame baked)

cache_frame_end.description: Frame on which the simulation stops (last frame baked)

cache_frame_offset.description: Frame offset that is used when loading the simulation from the cache. It is not considered when baking the simulation, only when loading it.

cache_mesh_format.description: Select the file format to be used for caching surface data

cache_data_format.description: Select the file format to be used for caching volumetric data

cache_particle_format.description: Select the file format to be used for caching particle data

cache_noise_format.description: Select the file format to be used for caching noise data

cache_type.description: Change the cache type of the simulation

cache_resumable.description: Additional data will be saved so that the bake jobs can be resumed after pausing. Because more data will be written to disk it is recommended to avoid enabling this option when baking at high resolutions.

cache_directory.description: Directory that contains fluid cache files

timesteps_max.description: Maximum number of simulation steps to perform for one frame

use_slice.description: Perform a single slice of the domain object

slice_per_voxel.description: How many slices per voxel should be generated

display_thickness.description: Thickness of smoke display in the viewport

display_interpolation.description: Interpolation method to use for smoke/fire volumes in solid mode

vector_field.description: Vector field to be represented by the display vectors

use_color_ramp.description: Render a simulation field while mapping its voxels values to the colors of a ramp or using a predefined color code

gridlines_color_field.description: Simulation field to color map onto gridlines

gridlines_lower_bound.description: Lower bound of the highlighting range

gridlines_range_color.description: Color used to highlight the range

flow_behavior.description: Change flow behavior in the simulation

velocity_factor.description: Multiplier of source velocity passed to fluid (source velocity is non-zero only if object is moving)

velocity_coord.description: Additional initial velocity in X, Y and Z direction (added to source velocity)

density_vertex_group.description: Name of vertex group which determines surface emission rate

proposed_control.source: Fresh --factory-startup, no project helper or old cache
proposed_control.secondary_setter: Only assign when current differs; verify actual booleans and particle types after reopen
proposed_control.physical_settings: Factory defaults recorded in factory.domain/flow; no fractions, no obstacle deletion, FLIP .97, adaptive1-4 CFL2
proposed_control.cache_resumable_reason: Extra diagnostic state; must inspect actual exported grids, do not promise pressure/obstacle exist
proposed_control.linear_cost_not_guaranteed: Default mesh2 increases surface meshing plus startup/I/O overhead
